gates.tier: G-A and G-F on the final tier; G-N compares development and final tier

band.in_band: |d| < 2 q (t - 1) on the stage-t grid (the open support of the summed shock differences before stage t)
band.edge_node: a node at exactly |d| = 2 q (t - 1) is out of band

recovery.grid: symmetric grid on D_T with step 0.5 (recovery_step)
recovery.note: At T = 3 the tail set |d| >= 2 q within D_3 is 100 to 400 per side at q = 50 (T = 2: 100 to 200); the threshold 0.02 is v2.0's but the set is larger.

statistics.pairing: (q, seed); n = the number of complete pairs of that (q, hypothesis)
statistics.indices: numpy.random.default_rng(S).integers(0, n, size=(10000, n)), created afresh with the same S for every (hypothesis, q, statistic)
statistics.interval_method: numpy.percentile (default linear method) of the 10,000 resampled means
statistics.median_interval: the same percentiles of the 10,000 resampled medians, from the same indices
statistics.failed_runs: every planned run is reported; a run with a nonzero exit (after the crash rule) counts as failed in the gate counts; its metrics are missing and its pair is dropped from the paired statistics; the number of dropped pairs is reported

primary.support_rule: a hypothesis is supported iff the upper end of the 95 % interval of the mean paired difference (a - b) is strictly below 0 at q = 50 and at q = 60; otherwise not supported, and the report names the q at which it fails

H1.reads: BW against the original joint scheme

H2.reads: whether BW still has the lower full-domain gain once the joint scheme has exploring starts; compares the two schemes as implemented, not a coverage-matched test of the backward order

H3.reads: whether the coverage that exploring starts give helps the joint scheme

H1-T2.reads: H1 at T = 2 on the v2.0 confirmation seeds 30501-30520 (re-evaluated recorded runs against the new arm)

secondary.pairs: the four pairs of the hypotheses

reading_rule.if_met: v2.0's design at T = 3 is a candidate for a T = 3 lock; the next round would lock it and confirm it on a fresh T = 3 seed block
reading_rule.if_not_met: the reports give the per-gate, per-stage diagnosis; no change is tried in this round
